It is a reflection of the Islamic concept of tawakkul, or trust and reliance on Allah, and the belief that Allah is the ultimate provider. The name encourages the individual to have a sense of gratitude and appreciation for the blessings they have received, and to remember that all good things come from Allah. It also serves as a reminder to place our trust and hope in Allah, and to remember that He is always with us and taking care of us, even in times of hardship or difficulty.
